div.div:
overlap(a, b) ⇔ a.check_in < b.check_out AND a.check_out > b.check_in
nights = check_out − check_in (no +1). Only status = 'confirmed' bookings and blocked_dates count.

div.div:
One clause, rules.unavailable_exists(), used in four places
• GET /listings search: NOT EXISTS correlated on Listing.id (one SQL query)
• GET /listings/{id}/quote: is_available() → 409
• POST /bookings: is_available() inside _booking_lock → 409
• POST /listings/{id}/blocks: a block can't overlap a booking or block → 409
Frontend: RangeCalendar disables start … end−1 of each range from GET /availability.
